$comment: ADDITIONAL check alongside testdata/vectors/bulk-write-categorization.json, not a substitute for it. That family (47 curated cases) is REGENERATED from upstream on every `make vectors` run, so it catches upstream drift; it cannot cover a combination nobody wrote down. THIS file is 600 RANDOMISED write sequences from the same upstream function at the same pin, frozen: it can never detect upstream drift, but it reaches multi-row and multi-error interactions no curator imagined (318 cases produce at least one error, 466 batch two to four rows against one document snapshot). Both run. Only regenerate this if dxdb-storage's own behaviour is intentionally changed.
